name: Enchanted Straw Appendage's proc scares the creature it hits (#9602)
contract: Enchanted Straw Appendage's equip spell is 303023, a passive aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 303024 Panic, with tiers 312819/316819/320819 on the same item name. Their Spell.dbc records carry ProcFlags 0 and ProcChance 2 and the world had no spell_proc row, so Aura::GetProcEffectMask found no proc entry and the roll never ran (#9602). The tooltips promise a chance upon dealing direct magic damage; the tiers add a 90 sec internal cooldown. The repair grants PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_NEG at the hit phase over every school and spell family and defers Chance to the record's ProcChance 2. spell_proc_chance reads the loaded entries' 2, and aura_proc_rate replays the aura's native proc decision 40000 times on a synthetic landed magic-class direct hit naming Frostbolt 116: about 2% for the direct hit, zero for a melee-class hit and for a periodic tick. Before the repair the chance lookups fail with 'Spell has no proc entry' and every rate reads 0.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: base proc dummy aura is applied
SETUP: top tier proc dummy aura is applied
DISCRIMINATING: landed direct magic damage procs the base dummy at about 2%
DISCRIMINATING: landed direct magic damage procs the top tier dummy at about 2%
CONTROL: a melee-class hit is not magic damage
CONTROL: a periodic tick is not a landed direct hit
